note: The session status vocabulary both apps must agree on. The web server emits these wire strings (web/mesh.js, web/agent-events.js); the web client renders them (web/public/app.js) and the macOS app maps them onto ClaudeSession.SessionStatus and renders them (Sources/AgentHub/Views). When the vocabulary changes, this file changes in the same commit and both suites fail until both sides agree.

wireCases.name: an explicit needsInput string maps to needs input
an explicit working string maps to working
an explicit idle string maps to idle
an explicit ended string maps to ended, not unknown
an explicit unknown string maps to unknown
a missing status maps to unknown
an unrecognised status maps to unknown
